description: Defines mapping strategies for converting thing search commands into JSON-compatible mappers, including handling of subscription creation, cancellation, and request commands within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommandMappingStrategies
classes.description: Singleton class providing mapping strategies from signal types to JSON mappers for thing search commands.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThingSearchCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns the map of signal type strings to their corresponding JSON mappers.

methods.name: namespacesFrom
methods.description: Extracts a set of namespace strings from an Adaptable object.

methods.name: filterFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the filter string from an Adaptable object, if present.

methods.name: optionsFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the options string from an Adaptable object, if present.

methods.name: demandFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the demand value from an Adaptable object, defaulting to 0.
